Croatian rules ( CIUS-HR and EXT-HR ) - terms of the publisher

Publisher: Porezna uprava ( Tax Administration ), Ministarstvo financija, Republika Hrvatska.

The pages of the publisher state ( written here without diacritics ):
"Sva prava pridrzana (c) 2023 Republika Hrvatska, Ministarstvo financija, Porezna uprava. Sadrzaji s ovih stranica se
mogu prenositi bez posebne dozvole uz navodjenje izvora."
In English: all rights reserved; the contents of these pages may be passed on without special permission, provided the
source is named.

The Schematron files themselves carry no licence and no copyright line. The rule package of VAMPIRE is a translation of
the Schematron into the rule format of the engine, not the original file; the message texts are reproduced unchanged.
As the condition asks, every package and every NOTICE names the source:
